## About
Jake's Auto Parts serves the area with quality used parts from our spot on Mt Elliott St in Detroit.
Our parts are tracked in an inventory management system and updated daily. Can't find what you need? Call or email us and we'll track it down.
The terms are simple. Mechanical parts come with a warranty. Electrical and body parts are sold as-is. Customers rate us 4.6 from 68 Google reviews.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used parts for your car, tracked in an inventory system that's updated daily.
- Finding the part you need: If the part isn't in our inventory, call or email us and we'll find it for you.
- Shipping: Need a part sent out? Call us for shipping information.

## FAQ
Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Mechanical parts come with a 60-day warranty. There is no labor warranty.

Q: Are electrical and body parts sold as-is?
A: Yes. Electrical and body parts are sold as-is.

Q: What if you don't have the part I need?
A: Call or email us. We have access to over 200 million parts and will find it for you.
